scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage SilumgarScavengerTest#test_BoostOnDies. 1 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[exploited-predicate-missing]: DBPump's ConditionPresent$ Card.exploited uses a predicate the filter vocabulary lacks (there is no exploited case in the card-property matcher), so UnknownPredicates fails the condition closed and Haste is never granted. The +1/+1 counter lands: the exploit sacrifice answer (p0:Balduvian Bears) is consumed in the committed run and the counter is present, and the yes/no exploit election is absent from the committed scenario (the port dropped that XMage choice). Observed p0:Silumgar Scavenger has the counter but lacks Haste. CR 702.110a/b. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.
